_comment: Known contextual events given to the LLM-as-a-Judge (events within +-6 months of an anomaly). Curated by the data steward: add, correct or remove entries through a pull request. Keep only events with a verifiable source. 'month' is YYYY-MM; 'kind' is policy, political, monetary or external.
